description: Perimetrazione delle aree con pericolosità da frana derivate dall inventario dei fenomeni franosi - Livello di dettaglio is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by adbarno.it. The information layer identifies areas subject to gravitative slope deformations identified through detailed studies with cartographic return greater than or equal to the 1:10,000 scale. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Perimeter of areas with landslides hazards derived from the inventory of landslides — Level of detail" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Pianificazione. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
